import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_VAL = 100005;
    static final int MOD_VAL = 1000000007;
    static long[] lookup = new long[17];

    public static long computeCost(long val, int level) {
        if (level == 0) {
            return (val == 0) ? 0 : MOD_VAL;
        }
        long count = val / lookup[level];
        if (val % lookup[level] == 0) {
            return level * count;
        }
        long costOption1 = computeCost(Math.abs(val - lookup[level] * (count + 1)), level - 1) + level;
        long costOption2 = computeCost(val - lookup[level] * count, level - 1);
        return Math.min(level * (count + 1) + costOption1 - level, level * count + costOption2);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        lookup[1] = 1;
        for (int i = 2; i < 17; ++i) {
            lookup[i] = lookup[i - 1] * 10 + 1;
        }
        long val = sc.nextLong();
        System.out.println(computeCost(val, 16));
        sc.close();
    }
}
